name: Complete plan parity, observability, compatibility, and gated rollout

rounds.prompt:
Finish the end-to-end ontology-driven implementation system in docs/spec/ontology-spec.md by closing surface, observability, compatibility, security, and rollout gaps after the core behavior is reviewable.

Behavior
- Expose shared read operations equivalent to refine goal plan <goal-id>, --model, and --steps through CLI structured JSON, API, and MCP. In web Goal detail, summarize active progress; show full model, revisions, step attempts/outcomes, checkpoints, impacts, discrepancies, findings, and context-selection evidence only in explicit plan/evidence/log views.
- Emit structured activity for operation, Goal, Round, plan/revision, step/process/provider, Governance revision/digest, model digest/version, state transition, selected model/Architecture records with reasons, Rule findings/evidence, checkpoints, retry/replan/cancellation/interruption/recovery, and validation/conflict errors. Record Governance digest, base commit, and Goal-history version needed to reproduce derivation.
- Ensure a completed/failed plan is durably readable from its Round while never presenting plans/steps as Rounds, Round counts, Goal statuses, or independent workflow state.
- Complete shared-service parity across Workflow, web, CLI, API, MCP, background operations, and agents; equivalent validation/revision conflicts must have equivalent typed contracts. Extend Smoke AI so integration tests can deterministically emit valid/invalid models, plans, step results, discrepancies, and Governance verdicts.
- Finish rollout controls: legacy one-shot remains available; no Architecture and old Round/context-v1 data work normally; setting-controlled planned execution can be disabled safely. Re-run the pre-registered efficacy experiment from the first Goal against the integrated system and require its quality, fixed cost, and failure-shape gates before enabling any broader default.

Constraints and architecture
- Durable Round, operation, process, Git, and Governance state is authoritative; dashboard/progress projections are summaries only.
- Provider/authentication failures remain visible as provider failures, never validation, plan, or workflow-capacity errors. Retain/redact raw provider evidence under existing security/export rules.
- Planning is read-only; step agents are isolated; proposals require explicit user mutation; API/remote-browser origin rules apply; no executable Governance content or new merge/approval authority exists.
- Do not build the deferred editable visual projection, graph store, React conversion, concurrent same-worktree execution, rule schema, or comprehensive-Architecture requirement.

Implementation order
1. Add plan query/progress/evidence projections through the shared capability.
2. Add thin surface adapters and structured observability.
3. Complete Smoke AI, migration/compatibility, security, origin, and failure-classification coverage.
4. Run the full cross-surface/system verification matrix.
5. Re-run and record the fixed efficacy gate; keep planned execution opt-in if the threshold is not met.

Verification
- Cover Architecture absent/small/full; legacy one-shot Round with no plan; old context-v1; valid one/multi-step plans; replans; failures; cancellation; restart; and completed Review.
- Prove CLI/API/MCP/web parity, thin adapters, exact structured errors, durable readback, and no plan/step leakage into public workflow semantics.
- Run focused/unit/integration/real-browser tests, Smoke AI end-to-end cases, formatting, strict linting, release build, and relevant registered Quality checks; separate unrelated baseline failures from touched behavior.
- Publish exact final efficacy results and the resulting default/opt-in decision. The Feature is complete only when every acceptance criterion in docs/spec/ontology-spec.md is either verified or explicitly retained behind the failed efficacy gate without misreporting implementation success.

Explicit final contract audit
- Before declaring the Feature complete, verify durable readback of the exact plan and step enums, adaptive seam-and-redo-cost sizing behavior, context-version-2 compatibility, all prompt templates including `plan-step-execute.md`, transcript aggregation, strict needs-input behavior, `refine governance rules list` parity, aspirational-Rule behavior without baseline/debt/ratchet state, and every discrepancy classification's prescribed response.
- Treat this as a fail-closed audit of behavior owned by earlier Goals, not permission to introduce first-time architecture in the hardening Goal. Any missing contract returns to the owning Goal or a narrow recovery Round with evidence.
- Confirm the human-recorded Goal 1 gate decision from durable state before planned execution is broadened; Feature ordering or implementation completion alone is not a passing efficacy decision.
